item.title: Quanta Computer and Quantinuum Partner on Scalable Quantum Computing Hardware
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – Quanta Computer (“Quanta”), a Fortune Global 500 manufacturer of advanced computing and cloud infrastructure, and Quantinuum (Nasdaq: QNT), a leading quantum computing company, today announced a collaborative development agreement to help establish an industrial foundation for the next era of quantum computing.
